items.bullet_summary_preload:
- Two FBI agents and two prosecutors, including election fraud prosecutor **Dan Bishop**, questioned **Richard Barron** for over two hours Friday in Atlanta[2].
- Questions centered on 17,852 missing ballot images and double-scanned ballots, nearly 10 months after the FBI seized Fulton's 2020 ballots on Jan. 28[2][3].
- Barron, who cooperated without a subpoena, called the session cordial and said prosecutors want to meet again; no evidence of widespread violations has surfaced[1][3].
